PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Ctrl-Z / Ctrl-Y undo and redo for building, painting, grid paste and delete, terminal changes and text fields.
PluginData.Description:
Undo and redo with Ctrl-Z / Ctrl-Y - Placing and removing blocks, grid splits included - Painting and skins - Pasting and deleting grids - Terminal property changes, block and grid names - Programmable block programs - Single line text fields - Grid history: put a deleted grid back on the clipboard
The history is saved with the world and follows its backups. Works offline, when hosting, and as far as the server allows when connected to one. In survival only what you could do by hand, unless creative tools are enabled.
Relative dampeners and toggle all reactors move to Ctrl-Shift-Z and Ctrl-Shift-Y. All keys can be changed in the plugin settings.
Please see the full documentation on GitHub: https://github.com/viktor-ferenczi/se-undo
